# Beta 1.0.8 · October 2026

## Things that behave better
- Web searches and page opens work again when your secrets folder holds a large file, such as a saved sign-in. The check that runs before each one couldn't handle a file that big, so it blocked every search.
- When that check can't run, its notice in the chat no longer shows anything from your secrets folder. Before, the error it showed could include saved sign-in details.
- Routines that broke in Beta 1.0.7 work again: the nightly notes cleanup, and the weekend routines that suggest new routines.
- Canvas sync no longer gives up when a course's assignment list arrives cut short; it asks again.
